2123. Printing a Right-Angled Triangle Pattern of Stars

90

Hard

Problem Statement
Read an integer N and print a right-angled triangle pattern of stars with N rows, using nested for loops.

Description
Read an integer N from input. Use an outer for loop to control the row number, running from 1 to N. Use an inner for loop inside it to print a number of '*' characters equal to the current row number, with no spaces between them. After each row's stars are printed, move to a new line before starting the next row.
input_spec:
. Use an outer for loop to control the row number, running from 1 to N. Use an inner for loop inside it to print a number of '*' characters equal to the current row number, with no spaces between them. After each row's stars are printed, move to a new line before starting the next row.

Input Description
A single integer N (N >= 1).
output_spec: Print N rows, where row i contains i stars.
